title: “Girls with girls”: gender composition and team performance in survey data collection
title_zh: 女孩与女孩”：性别构成与调查数据采集中的团队绩效
authors: Qing Huang, Yingyue Quan
abstract: We investigate the impact of gender composition on team performance in a real-world setting using a large-scale survey conducted within Chinese firms. We study the performance of two-person interviewer teams, with gender composition randomly assigned, tasked with complex survey data collection. Our analysis shows that two-female teams outperform both mixed-gender and two-male teams in interview completion and refusal-based questionnaire quality. Specifically, assignment to an all-female team increases the likelihood of completing an interview by 2.4%, and reduces refusals to answer key questions by 5%. This performance difference is likely driven by improved task coordination and a more favorable communication environment in all-female teams. This leads to increased effort input and ultimately enhances team effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 我们利用在中国企业内部开展的大规模调查，在真实情境中探究性别构成对团队绩效的影响。研究对象为随机分配性别组合的两人访谈员团队，其任务为完成复杂的调查数据采集工作。分析表明，全女性团队在访谈完成率和基于拒答的问卷质量方面均优于混合性别团队及全男性团队。具体而言，被分配至全女性团队可使访谈完成概率提升2.4%，并将关键问题拒答率降低5%。这一绩效差异很可能源于全女性团队中任务协调的改善与更有利的沟通环境，进而促使团队成员投入更多努力，最终提升团队效能。

title: Disastrous Displacement: The Long-Run Impacts of Landslides
title_zh: 灾难性迁移：山体滑坡的长期影响
authors: Baseler, Travis, Hennig, Jakob
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Natural disasters displace millions of people a year, but their economic impacts are difficult to study when the affected population becomes dispersed. This paper estimates the longrun impacts of six landslides in Uganda on nearly the full affected population. The analysis exploits the sharp boundaries between households residing in a landslide path and those on the same slopes but outside the path. Years after the landslides, affected households earn 50% less income and are 18 percentage points less likely to report being satisfied with their lives. Further analysis points to social capital as a determinant of successful post-disaster recovery.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害每年导致数百万人流离失所，但当受灾人口分散时，其经济影响难以研究。本文估算了乌干达六次山体滑坡对几乎全部受灾人口的长期影响。分析利用了滑坡路径内住户与同处同一山坡但位于路径外住户之间的清晰边界。滑坡发生数年后，受灾家庭收入减少50%，对生活表示满意的可能性降低18个百分点。进一步分析表明，社会资本是灾后成功恢复的决定性因素。

title: The Effects of Education on Corruption: Evidence from Vietnam's University Expansion
title_zh: 教育对腐败的影响：来自越南大学扩张的证据
authors: Malesky, Edmund J., Mattsson, Martin, Vu, Khoa, Zhang, Liaoliang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Education and corruption are negatively correlated at the cross-national level, but little is known about the causal relationship between the two. We combine newly-collected data on timing and locations of Vietnam's national expansion of universities with detailed survey data on experiences of corruption from over 170,000 respondents in 320 districts across 12 years. Using staggered difference-in-differences, we show that cohorts exposed to the university expansion are 78% more likely to have a university education. However, this increase neither translates into fewer individuals being affected by corruption nor increases the propensity to denounce corrupt officials. Instead, we find that education increases exposure to corruption at the individual level. The mechanism for this increase that is most consistent with our data is that education raises household income and higher income leads to more bribe payments.
abstract_zh: 教育与腐败在国家层面呈负相关，但两者间的因果关系尚不明确。本研究将越南全国大学扩张的时间与地点新数据，与涵盖12年间320个地区逾17万受访者腐败经历详情的调查数据相结合。采用交错双重差分法分析发现，受大学扩张影响的群体接受高等教育的概率提升78%。然而，这一增长既未转化为受腐败影响人数的减少，也未提高举报腐败官员的倾向。相反，我们发现教育在个体层面增加了腐败暴露风险。与数据最吻合的机制解释是：教育提高了家庭收入，而更高收入导致更多贿赂支出。

title: Noncausal AR processes driven by causal GARCH volatility
title_zh: 因果GARCH波动驱动的非因果AR过程
authors: Daniel Velásquez-Gaviria, Jean-Michel Zakoïan
abstract: This paper studies the introduction of causal conditional heteroskedasticity in noncausal autoregressive (AR) models. We demonstrate that, in this framework, large shocks to the innovation process driving the GARCH error term of a noncausal AR model result in heightened volatility immediately before and after a bubble crash. The non-coincidence of the σ -fields generated by past observations and past values of the GARCH process makes statistical inference nonstandard. In particular, the full quasi-maximum likelihood estimator (QMLE) is generally inconsistent. We investigate the asymptotic properties of three-step weighted least squares estimators of the AR coefficient and the QMLE of the volatility parameters. Our findings are illustrated by Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application to financial data.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在非因果自回归（AR）模型中引入因果条件异方差性的方法。我们证明，在该框架下，驱动非因果AR模型GARCH误差项的创新过程中的大幅冲击，会导致泡沫崩溃前后波动性显著加剧。由于过去观测值生成的σ域与GARCH过程过去值生成的σ域不重合，统计推断变得非标准。具体而言，完全拟极大似然估计量（QMLE）通常不一致。我们研究了AR系数的三步加权最小二乘估计量以及波动率参数的QMLE的渐近性质。通过蒙特卡洛实验和对金融数据的实证应用，本文验证了上述发现。

authors: Yuriy Gorodnichenko, Debora Revoltella, Jan Svejnar, Christoph T. Weiss
abstract: Using a new survey, we document high dispersion of marginal revenue products across firms in the European Union. To interpret this dispersion, we develop a highly portable framework to quantify gains from better allocation of resources. We demonstrate that apart from direct measures of distortions, firm characteristics, such as demographics, quality of inputs, utilization of resources, and dynamic adjustment of inputs, are predictors of the marginal revenue products of capital and labor. We emphasize that some firm characteristics may reflect compensating differentials rather than constraints and the effect of constraints on the dispersion of marginal products may be smaller. (JEL D22, D24, D25, E23, G31, L25)

title: The Green Peace Dividend: The Effects of Militarisation on Emissions and the Green Transition
title_zh: 绿色和平红利：军事化对排放与绿色转型的影响
authors: Balázs Markó
abstract: This paper argues that military buildups lead to a significant rise in greenhouse gas emissions and can disrupt the green transition. Identifying military spending shocks, I use local projections to show that a percentage point rise in the military spending share leads to a 0.9–2% rise in total emissions, as well as a 1% rise in emission intensity, depending on the economy’s overall emission intensity. Using a dynamic production network model calibrated for the US, I find that a permanent shock of the same size would increase total emissions by between 0.25% and 1.38%, and emission intensity by between 0.12% and 1.06%. The empirical analysis tentatively suggests that green patenting may be reduced by 10–25% following such a shock, and the model suggests that investment in renewables could be crowded out by defence spending under certain circumstances, hindering the energy transition. I show in a directed technical change model that crowding out green innovation could result in the growth rate - not just the level - of emissions becoming higher. These effects can significantly raise climate damages. Depending on the social cost of carbon and the composition of a military spending shock, I estimate that permanently doubling the military spending share in the US in 2017 (equal to 3.3% of GDP) would have led to climate damages equivalent to between 0.05–1.81% of US GDP per year.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，军事扩张会导致温室气体排放显著增加，并可能阻碍绿色转型。通过识别军事支出冲击，我采用局部投影法证明：军事支出占比每上升1个百分点，总排放量将增加0.9%-2%，排放强度将上升1%（具体幅度取决于经济体的整体排放强度）。基于为美国校准的动态生产网络模型，我发现同等规模的永久性冲击将使总排放量增加0.25%-1.38%，排放强度提高0.12%-1.06%。实证分析初步表明，此类冲击后绿色专利数量可能减少10%-25%；模型则显示，特定条件下国防支出可能挤出可再生能源投资，阻碍能源转型。在定向技术变革模型中，我证明挤出绿色创新可能导致排放增长率（而非仅排放水平）上升。这些效应将显著加剧气候损害。根据碳的社会成本及军事支出冲击的构成，我估算：若2017年美国军事支出占比（相当于GDP的3.3%）永久性翻倍，由此导致的气候损害将相当于美国GDP的0.05%-1.81%/年。

title_zh: 押注希特勒——纳粹德国政治关联的价值
authors: Hans-Joachim Voth, Thomas Ferguson
official: 官方在线 2005-04-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine the effect of close ties with the NSDAP on the stock price of listed firms in 1932-33. We consider not only links between the National Socialists and executives, as was common in earlier work, but also with supervisory board members ? whose importance is hard to overestimate in the case of German industry. One implication of our work is that, weighted by stock market capitalization in 1932, more than half of listed firms on the Berlin stock exchange had substantive links with the NSDAP. Crucially, stock market investors recognized the value of these links, sending the share prices of connected firms up as the new regime became firmly established. While the market as a whole rose after Hitler?s accession to power, firms with board members known to favour the party (or backing it financially) outperformed the market by 5-10% between January and May 1933. We show that this finding is robust to a range of additional control variables and alternative estimation techniques.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1932-1933年间与纳粹党（NSDAP）的密切关系对上市公司股票价格的影响。我们不仅考虑了纳粹党与高管之间的联系（这在早期研究中较为常见），还关注了与监事会成员的联系——在德国工业的背景下，后者的重要性无论如何强调都不为过。我们的研究结论之一是，按1932年股票市值加权计算，柏林证券交易所超过一半的上市公司与纳粹党存在实质性联系。关键在于，股票市场投资者认识到了这些联系的价值，随着新政权稳固建立，关联企业的股价随之上涨。尽管希特勒上台后整个市场整体上扬，但在1933年1月至5月期间，董事会成员已知支持该党（或为其提供资金支持）的企业表现优于市场5-10%。我们证明，这一发现在一系列额外控制变量和替代估计方法下依然稳健。

title: Fair Wages in a New Keynesian Model of the Business Cycle
title_zh: 新凯恩斯主义商业周期模型中的公平工资
authors: Jean-Pierre Danthine, André Kurmann
official: 官方在线 2002-06-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We build a New Keynesian model of the business cycle with sticky prices and real wage rigidities motivated by efficiency wages of the gift exchange variety. Compared to a standard sticky price model, our Fair Wage model provides an explanation for structural employment and generates more plausible labour market dynamics, notably accounting for the low correlation between wages and employment. The fair wage induced real wage rigidity also significantly reduces the elasticity of marginal cost with respect to output. The smoother dynamics of real marginal cost increase both amplification and persistence of output responses to monetary shocks, thus remedying the well-known lack of internal propagation of standard sticky price models. We take these improvements as a strong endorsement of the addition of real wage rigidities to nominal price rigidities and conclude that the fair wage extension of this Paper constitutes a promising platform for an enriched New Keynesian synthesis.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含粘性价格与效率工资（礼物交换型）引发的实际工资刚性的新凯恩斯商业周期模型。相较于标准粘性价格模型，我们的公平工资模型不仅解释了结构性就业问题，还生成了更符合现实的劳动力市场动态，尤其能够解释工资与就业之间的低相关性。由公平工资引发的实际工资刚性显著降低了边际成本对产出的弹性。实际边际成本的平滑动态增强了产出对货币冲击的放大效应与持续性，从而弥补了标准粘性价格模型在内部传导机制上的不足。我们将这些改进视为对名义价格刚性基础上引入实际工资刚性的有力支持，并认为本文提出的公平工资扩展为丰富新凯恩斯综合理论提供了富有前景的研究平台。
